gita_dhyana.title: Gītā Dhyānam (nine traditional invocation verses) and Gītā chapter names
gita_dhyana.credits: Verses collated word by word from shlokam.org, mammully.blogspot.com and gyaandweep.com, with the GRETIL Bhagavadgītā preface (data/gita/gretil_preface.txt) as a further witness for five verses; chapter names from the vulgate colophons as listed on shlokam.org and Wikipedia. We typed the text ourselves from the cross-checked sources; variants are recorded in the file. No modern translation or commentary is used.
gita_dhyana.licence: Public domain (pre-modern verses and traditional chapter names); our typed transcription is released with the project
